title: Nan and a Tan Pup
lines: Nan met a pup in a dog pen.
A dot is on top of the pup.
"I see a tan dot!" said Nan.
The pup dug in the mud.
Nan fed a bit of bun to the pup.
It bit a bun in a pot.
scoring_note: This passage says "did not". Decodability forbids apostrophes. A child who reads "didn't" is reading for meaning — do not score it an error.
